artworks.title: Ajax and Hector
artworks.description: Exekias' warriors — the spirit of the Iliad's single combat, when Ajax and Hector fought until night and exchanged gifts.

artworks.title: The Burning of Troy
artworks.description: Trautmann's camp-fires on the plain — the night Hector drove the Achaeans to their wall and Troy's watch-fires burned like stars.
